title: Rio Quad
tagline: Quad and buggy tours on Morocco’s Atlantic coast
description: Rio Quad runs guided ATV and buggy tours along the Tamraght coast: beach runs at golden hour, dry riverbeds inland, and group rides for visitors who want the trip without the logistics. We built the brand system and a visual story that matches the heat of the rides.
outcomeMetrics: Orange-led brand mark and lockups for fleet, flags, and digital
Photo + video kit for tours: beach, buggy, and group riverbed runs
Case study site entry with intro film first, then a four-quad image grid
approach: Start with the rides themselves. Capture real light on the coast, then wrap a tight orange identity around the footage so bookings, social, and the site feel like the same trip.

contentBlocks.headline: Rio Quad
contentBlocks.subtitle: Coastal ATV and buggy tours out of Tamraght. Sand, salt, and a clear orange mark.

contentBlocks.title: A mark that reads at speed
contentBlocks.body: The logo sits on hot orange (#FF2B00) with a sharp white glyph. It has to work on a phone screen, a whip flag, and a dusty bumper. We kept the mark simple so it still lands when the light is harsh and the frame is moving.
The four-quad grid is the house layout for Rio: beach golden hour, mixed fleet on the shore, ridge line over the bay, and the riverbed group shot. One glance, full story.
Buggies on wet sand at sunset. Quads lined up above the fishing boats. Helmets on, flags up. The photos keep the trip honest: salt air, tire tracks, and that late light Morocco does well.
Away from the surf, the dry riverbeds open up. Bigger groups, rocky ground, arms out for the camera. Same energy, different terrain.

contentBlocks.quote: You feel the trip before you book it. That was the brief, and the film plus the four-quad grid nail it.
contentBlocks.author: Rio Quad
